remarks: Welcome to 51 Glen Avenue, your next project in the heart of West Norwalk! This classic ranch-style home offers a fantastic opportunity for those with a vision. The home includes three spacious bedrooms and one full bathroom, this property is a blank canvas waiting for your personal touch. It sits on a generous lot, providing ample space for outdoor activities, gardening, and more. The single-story layout ensures ease of access and comfortable living, while the floor plan holds endless possibilities for customization. Though the home is in need of work, the potential here is undeniable. With some TLC, this property could be transformed into a modern haven or a cozy retreat. Located in the desirable West Norwalk area, this home is close to local amenities, parks, and schools, making it an ideal location for those looking to capitalize on the vibrant community. Whether you're a seasoned renovator or a first-time buyer ready to make your mark, this house is your chance to create something truly special. Imagine designing your dream kitchen, updating the bathroom to your taste, and crafting a backyard oasis that will be the envy of the neighborhood. Please note, this home is being sold as is. Don't miss out on this rare opportunity to own a piece of West Norwalk and turn this diamond in the rough into a shining gem. Schedule a viewing today and let your imagination run wild with the possibilities that await at this promising property!
